title: Practice 1: Someone who does or is something

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **жи́тель** — inhabitant, resident, occupant, dweller. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**житель** — жи́тель: inhabitant, resident, occupant, dweller. Wiktionary: жить + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **смотри́тель** — supervisor, inspector, keeper, custodian. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**смотритель** — смотри́тель: supervisor, inspector, keeper, custodian. Wiktionary: смотре́ть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **люби́тель** — lover, devotee, fan. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
**любителя** — люби́тель: lover, devotee, fan; amateur, dilettante. Wiktionary: люби́ть + -тель.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: жи́тель — inhabitant, resident, occupant, dweller; смотри́тель — supervisor, inspector, keeper, custodian; люби́тель — lover, devotee, fan; чита́тель — reader.
**чита́тель** — reader. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **писа́тель** — writer. Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.

exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **слу́шатель** — listener, hearer, audience (someone who listens). Source: Wiktionary, «-тель» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-тель#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there and in the Russian Wiktionary.
